# BoopFace

- Package: [boopface](https://www.npmjs.com/package/boopface) 0.8.0 (npm tarball sha256 `ff3e4bd350f5daf41b04ef3854304497d57955cadacf80194ec5ba8850831f40`)
- Source: https://github.com/CX-ArtLab/BoopFace
- License: MIT, © 2026 CX ART Lab (LICENSE)
- Files: `boopface.js` and `src/` from the package, unmodified. No network access; the skins load
  from `src/skins/` the first time one is shown.

Faradia uses it for the agents' faces (web/js/app/faces.js). To update it, replace these files with
the ones of a newer published version and update this note.
